overview_description.description:
Nestor is a Skills-based talent management platform that helps HR and business leaders identify, activate, and strategically deploy skills within their organization to drive peak performance, innovation, and growth.

With a market library of over 20,000 skills enhanced by Nestor’s AI skills suggestions, you gain unprecedented visibility into your people’s capabilities and dynamic mapping of their skills.
Our leading platform combines the tools, insights, and decision-making support you need to understand people’s strengths and skill gaps and leverage tailored learning recommendations to unlock hidden potential, in line with career and business goals.

Nestor’s Talent and Opportunity Marketplace helps connect talent with gigs, projects, or new open roles based on AI smart-matching, ensuring people with the right skills are in the right place at the right time.

Nestor is trusted by HR and people leaders in mid-to-large enterprises, including F500 companies, across the US, Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East.

product.name: AI Skills Management
product.description: A platform that uses AI to manage employee skills, enabling organizations to map, assess, and develop workforce capabilities aligned with business needs.

product.name: Talent & Opportunity Marketplace
product.description: An internal marketplace that matches employees with roles, projects, and gigs based on their skills and career interests to optimize talent deployment and internal mobility.

product.name: Skills-Driven Performance Management
product.description: A continuous performance management system that integrates skills data into goal setting, feedback, and reviews to enhance employee development and organizational alignment.

product.name: Talent Development
product.description: A solution focused on continuous upskilling and reskilling of employees to meet evolving industry demands and future workforce needs.

product.name: Employee Engagement and Survey Tools
product.description: Customizable survey tools for engagement, pulse, 360 feedback, and employee lifecycle surveys to gather insights and improve workplace culture.
